name: Shindou Akatsuki
source:
A 46-year-old free spirit.
He used to work for an investment trust management company, but quit because he was dissatisfied with not having any free time.
He is good at gambling, a type of skill game, and lives a carefree life based in Macau.

He dated Marina 14 years ago, and developed every inch of her body, which was almost like that of a virgin's.
In a sense, he is the person who has had the greatest influence on her life.

He returned to Japan temporarily after receiving news that his father, his only blood relative, was in critical condition.
During his stay, he contacted Marina, and after many twists and turns, they reignited their physical relationship for the first time since they initially met 14 years ago.

[Translated from [url=https://gyutto.com/i/item168088?select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url]]
